written_before: any edge, context, family or engine computation of this workstream
hypothesis: With one input (ESM++ small zca10 vectors) plus gene order, weighting similarity edges by neighbourhood agreement before clustering, K(a,a') = k(x_a,x_a') * sum_{d,d'} k(x_{a+d}, x_{a'+d'}), gives families as good as MMseqs2 families for the recurrence engine and removes the TXSScan loss of context-free embedding families.

definitions.vectors: embed_queue run dpann__esmpp_small__20261111, mean_raw_f32__uid.npy, transform zca10 exactly as embed_tokens.py (weights = genes per unique sequence)
definitions.candidate_edges: for each gene a with a vector: genes b in other genomes whose unique sequence is a's own (cosine 1) or one of the 50 HNSW neighbours of a's unique sequence (knn__esmpp_small__zca10__k50__hnsw.npz), ordered by cosine, ties (copies of one unique sequence) in random order (seed 17), capped at 64 per gene; undirected union of the directed lists; sim = zca10 cosine
definitions.neighbours: genes within +-w positions on the same contig that carry a vector, w in {1, 3, 5}
definitions.dense: c_a . c_a' / (n_a n_a') with c_a the sum of the neighbours' zca10 unit vectors (mean pairwise neighbour cosine)
definitions.matched: 0.5 * (sum_{i in N(a)} max_{j in N(a')} max(0, cos_ij - 0.14) + sum_{j in N(a')} max_{i in N(a)} max(0, cos_ij - 0.14))
definitions.null: per edge, the higher-gid endpoint replaced by a uniform random other gene of its genome (seed 17), one draw per edge, same score
definitions.support: per (form, w): edge supported if score >= t*, t* = smallest t > 0 with N_null(>=t) / N_obs(>=t) <= 0.01
definitions.gold_pairs: candidate edges whose two genes are both curated-caller members (gold/members.parquet); positive = the two genes share a (caller, system_type); per caller = both genes members of that caller; TXSScan-vs-nongold: one gene a TXSScan member, the other a TXSScan member of the same type (positive) or a gene in no gold instance (negative)
definitions.splits: tune = both genes in odd genome_code, test = both genes in even genome_code (edge level); engine: dpann_compare.py tune (odd) / test (even)

context_variant_selection: the (form, w) with the highest pooled AUROC of sim x ctx (same-type vs different-type gold pairs) on tune edges is the primary variant; the best variant of the other form on the same criterion is the secondary variant

arms.V0 sim_all: all candidate edges, weight sim (gene-level context-free control on the same edges)
arms.V1 simctx_sup: supported edges of the primary variant, weight sim x ctx
arms.V2 sim_sup: supported edges of the primary variant, weight sim (control: selection without weighting)
arms.V3 simctx_all: all candidate edges, weight sim x ctx of the primary variant (control: weighting without selection)
arms.V1b simctx_sup secondary: supported edges of the secondary variant, weight sim x ctx
arms.clustering: igraph Leiden, modularity, n_iterations -1, seed 17; resolutions from a grid, up to 4 per arm chosen by token count only (nearest to 120k, 200k, 300k, 430k within roughly 100k-450k; if an arm cannot reach the range, its lowest achievable token counts are used and this is reported)
arms.token_file: $RD/engine/dpann_tokens/ctx__esmpp_small__<variant>.parquet, all 3,585,303 gids, genes without an edge as singletons

selection_rule: among the context arms (V1, V1b, V3 at all resolutions) the arm with the highest tune (odd) summed DefenseFinder + TXSScan excess A - B is the chosen arm; V0 and V2 are controls and cannot be chosen

criteria_on_test_even.P1: chosen arm TXSScan excess A - B >= -0.04 (point estimate; 95% genome-bootstrap interval reported). Context-free graph arms: -0.074 to -0.095.
criteria_on_test_even.P2: chosen arm summed DefenseFinder + TXSScan excess A - B >= -0.01 (single input competitive); >= +0.02 counts as beating MMseqs2 families
criteria_on_test_even.P3: edge level, test edges, pooled callers, primary variant (or the variant of the chosen arm if that is the secondary): AUROC(sim x ctx) - AUROC(sim) >= 0.05 for same-type vs different-type gold pairs (genome-bootstrap 95% interval reported)

readings_and_refuters.context weighting rescues TXSScan: refuted if P1 fails; also refuted as a weighting effect if V2 (same supported edges, sim weight) reaches the same TXSScan excess (then edge selection, not weighting, does the work), and as a context effect if V0 (same candidate edges, no context) reaches it (then the gene-level edge construction does the work)
readings_and_refuters.context separates functional partners at: refuted if P3 fails, or if the TXSScan-vs-nongold AUROC of sim x ctx is not above that of sim (then context does not remove the composition-driven false similarity)

known_caveat_declared_in_advance: context-derived tokens use true gene order; the engine's within-genome token shuffle does not rebuild tokens, so its null is anti-conservative for these arms (BRIEF trap 3). Engine significant-pair counts and null pass rates are reported beside the base to show the size of this effect; the gold scorer's random-placement control is unaffected.
